# CASB Agency

CASB Agency Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian financial advisory agency established in 2006. The agency serves clients through Kuala Lumpur, Ipoh and Sibu branches and focuses on insurance protection planning, medical card education, critical illness protection, wealth planning, advisor development, and agency recognition.
